Serilog.Level.title: Log level
Serilog.Level.description: A Serilog log level threshold. Like SchemaStore's schema, this lists Off beside Serilog's six levels, and matches names exactly.

Serilog.LevelSwitch.title: Level switch name
Serilog.LevelSwitch.description: A reference to a level switch declared under LevelSwitches, with or without the leading dollar sign.

Serilog.LevelThreshold.title: Log level or switch
Serilog.LevelThreshold.description: A log level, or a reference to a level switch declared under LevelSwitches.

Default.description: The minimum level for sources without an override.

ControlledBy.description: A level switch ($name) that sets the default minimum level at runtime.

Override.title: Minimum level overrides
Override.description: Minimum levels per logging source: the key is a source context (a namespace or type name prefix, such as Microsoft.AspNetCore), the value a level or a level switch reference.
